claims_about_writeup.quote: submission/contribution.md — 223-word write-up of the method and its origin
claims_about_writeup.why: The write-up (title + three paragraphs) runs to roughly 220 words and does describe the origin of the stance direction (built from directed-modulation think/don't-think pairs), matching the message's description closely enough to be accurate.

rationale: Both the write-up and the closing message describe the method solely as a stance-contrast vector built from the repository's 'directed-modulation' family of think/don't-think pairs (a benchmark bank, not the prior-work source), with no mention of a white-bear steering paper, Raman 2026, or a white-bear-4b note anywhere in either document. Neither document frames the method as reproducing, building on, or being compared against any such named prior work, so there is no claim of novelty relative to a source to compare, and treatment of the source is identical (absent) in both.
